items.text: Hello Merchants,
It's hard to believe how much has changed since the launch of Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault in Early Access!

Over the past months, we've been working closely with all of you, reading your feedback, balancing the game, introducing new mechanics, and expanding Tresna with every major update. Every patch has been shaped by your suggestions, and today we'd like to take a moment to look back at everything we've added so far.

notes.title: Here's a quick summary of what has arrived in Early Access

items.text: 4 New Weapons
2 New Gadgets
1 New Armour
Hex and Poison Perk Paths
Boss Rush Mode
New Location - Greed Colosseum
The Endless Vault V and VI
BLOBLETS!!!
More combat rooms
Upgraded and New Vendors
New Shop Customizations
Balancing The Relics
New Shop Mechanics
New Quests and Cutscenes
and many more
None of this would have been possible without your incredible feedback. Every bug report, suggestion, balance discussion, and comment has helped us shape Moonlighter 2 into a better game.
But we're not done yet.

Our next news will be a very special one, as we'll finally reveal the release date for Version 1.0! We can't wait to share what's coming next and show you everything we've been preparing for the full launch.
Until then, thank you for joining us on this Early Access adventure.
See you soon in Tresna!
~ Digital Sun & 11 bit studios Teams
Hello Merchants!
Welcome back to another entry in our monthly Early Access development series!

We are happy to share that development is progressing according to plan, and we are still on track for the full release. Following the latest Blob-Life Update, which introduced new Bloblets companions, weapons, perks, Boss Rush Mode, and much more, the team is still hard at work preparing even more content for Version 1.0.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333092/3ecedc215850759564eb8c95c5347750c0b73da8.jpg"]
If you haven't had the chance to check it out yet, you can read more about the latest update here:
As we get closer to launch, we would like to give you a glimpse of the brand new equipment currently being forged for Moonlighter 2.
Meet the Endless weapon set and our newest armour, all inspired by the mysteries and riches of the Endless Vault:

Inspired by the Endless Vault's relentless pursuit of greater riches, this sword rewards aggressive play. Its special attack becomes a swift piercing strike that lands multiple hits, with the number of strikes increasing based on your combo. The longer you keep your momentum, the deadlier the weapon becomes.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333092/5455ef17cc094aebb50f3acc25d94eab93d11882.png"]

Crafted by the Golden Guild, this colossal weapon proves that true strength comes through resilience. Activating its special puts you into a defensive stance that blocks incoming attacks, increases Sharpness, and follows up with a devastating counterattack against your enemies.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333092/f097f474e6792c402c3d5f42c344b05d99a676c4.png"]

The Endless Spear is designed for those willing to risk everything in exchange for overwhelming power. Its special consumes all stored spearheads, transforming your basic attacks into empowered special attacks for a limited time, with bonus damage scaling based on the number of spearheads consumed.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333092/c5cdae3262075b35f70c04f9d3e873dd04ddac93.png"]

Built around the Endless Vault's philosophy of risk and reward, these gauntlets dramatically amplify your offensive potential. While Berserk is active, your attacks become significantly more powerful, encouraging an aggressive playstyle that rewards commitment.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333092/16daa738bef748c3f3bf4bab334441a328b91e97.png"]

Forged by the Golden Guild, the Endless Void armour embodies an insatiable hunger that can never truly be satisfied. Those deemed worthy by the Vault unlock its full potential, gaining increased base critical hit chance and additional critical damage for every Spark perk equipped.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333092/592fe7cbeb5c662c003f420a5d1b1823bdc7f6f8.png"]
There is still plenty more we'd love to show you before launch, but we'll save a few surprises for future updates.

As always, your feedback continues to shape Moonlighter 2 throughout Early Access, and we're incredibly grateful to everyone who shares their thoughts, reports issues, and helps us improve the game every month.
We're getting closer and closer to Version 1.0, and we can't wait for you to discover everything that awaits inside the Endless Vault.
See you in Tresna!
~ Digital Sun & 11 bit studios Teams

Hello merchants,
Even the bravest dungeon crawler needs a break sometimes. Between dangerous treasure runs and managing the shop, Will deserves a little companionship - and now he can finally get it.

The Blob-Life Balance Update is now live in Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault, bringing adorable Bloblet companions, new shop upgrades, tougher challenges, fresh gear, and many many more as we continue the road through Early Access toward full launch later this year.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333092/3ecedc215850759564eb8c95c5347750c0b73da8.jpg"]
Collectible Bloblets are here! Complete special tasks to earn a brand-new currency used to adopt these stylish little companions, each with their own unique look and apparel.
Once they settle into your shop, they grant temporary bonuses like:
Increased relic value
Better customer tips
Additional helpful boosts for your business
Because honestly, everything’s better with a Bloblet around.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333092/7952774ac52c6663f9a0ecb21025e1b71683c6a4.gif"]
You are into boss encouters?
Take a special run focused on power that’ll let you face the bosses sooner and learn a bit more about the story of each dimension… and they also reward you with new weapon aspects!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333092/78df5cea2b0aad3981e33121dbfa758a800a2d20.gif"]

releases.displayName: EA Progress #4 - Your feedback after the patch, and our next steps

items.text: Hello Merchants!
We are coming back to you with another monthly progress update, which will tease you a little bit, what we are about to implement next.

We just want to start by saying: we're so happy that so many of you jump back into portals, and we’ve been reading each one of your reviews, comments, and discussions. Seeing your excitement, on the road to release.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333092/ec654e889733114bdc2c03afd8e692c67b89d5b3.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333092/6f5356e37108ef11f3cd4f828af83bc7bc43b932.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333092/8d124765d4c37074bc96d9ca1ee3a157b74267be.png"]Of course, this are only couple of them and we couldn't pack them all here. <3
Expert Difficulty Mode

This has been one of the most requested features from the community, and we’re excited to announce it. A new difficulty mode where relics can be lost completely. Every run carries higher stakes, and every decision matters even more, and bring back the risk-reward dynamics which made first Moonlighter so unique.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333092/76896f80f6d2f70ed8c00e3c339f5e939f7aaa21.png"](all assets still WIP)
New Perk Path: Poison
Many of you have requested more perk variety, and we're already working on a new set of perks like Poison

This ailment will deal damage over time, and each tick increases its next damage, making it more dangerous the longer it stays active. However, Poison has a relatively short duration. You’ll need to keep reapplying it to maintain its growing power.
Let it drop, and the damage resets… so stay sharp.
(all assets still WIP)
Blobblet Skins

Yes! We’re adding new Blobblet skins with unique visuals and different effects. Rumblet, Guyblob Threepup, Mr. Spots and many many more will appear in Tresna, increasing value of your items, altering sell prices, and bringing a lot of cuteness.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333092/1dabf9e03edd50790f397bbe4de7cb6fab30f80f.png"](all assets still WIP)
Blo-Buddy
Meet your new companion: the Blo-Buddy which feels like an homage that will bring another part of ML1's flavour to ML2!

This new long-range weapon is a small floating friend that follows you around (yes, it’s as cute as it sounds). It fires whenever you press the shoot button, letting you attack while performing other actions at the same time.
It shoots rapidly with lower damage per hit, making it perfect for applying ailments like Ice or the new Poison.
(all assets still WIP)

Our aim of releasing Moonlighter 2 in Early Access was to create the best experience possible, which brings you fun for a bunch of time, and we are taking our time and care to test each idea, or suggestion that comes from the community.
We definitely hear you loud and clear when it comes to the Colosseum, and we are aware of the issues you have addressed recently so far.

Right now, it’s not hitting the balance we want. Enemies can feel a bit too spongy, and the risk-reward ratio isn’t as satisfying as it should be. This is something we're already tackling. We just want to make sure we approach it carefully and implement changes properly.
That said, you can expect adjustments to this mode based directly on your feedback soon, as we constantly try to improve your experience.
We are also aware of some minor crashes and bugs, which we are constantly working on at the moment.
As always, keep the feedback coming. You’re helping us shape Moonlighter 2 every step of the way, and we couldn’t do this without you.
Stay tuned and see you next month!
~ Digital Sun and 11 bit studios Teams

Hello Merchants,

Our 1st Early Access Content Update is live! As we mentioned before, we’re constantly gathering your feedback, which helps us improve your experience in Tresna. This is the first Content Update, but there’s still more to come before the full release.

As a reminder: during Early Access there will be one more Content Update, followed by even more content when version 1.0 launches. We’ll keep teasing what’s coming in our monthly updates and keep you informed about our progress!

notes.title: Below you can find our updated Roadmap

items.text: In general, this patch makes the overall experience smoother for both new and returning players, and we cannot wait for your valuable feedback about it!
20 Combat Rooms Set
Nou & Anacard’s Perks Set
Sliver’s Perks Set
New Upgrades at Eris's and K33P3R's
Another Endless Vault Challenge to beat
Shop Cosmetics Set
New Dungeon Path
New Weapon and Armor
The Greed Colosseum
Improved Perks, Relics, and overall balance
…and more
After defeating a boss, you’ll unlock an alternative path: The Greed Colosseum.

It’s a completely new challenge with escalating difficulty that appears as soon as you unlock the fifth key in the Endless Vault. Sliver discovered this dangerous realm where only the bravest adventurers can test their skills.
The promise?
Legendary relics, more boss materials, and bigger rewards.
The cost?
If you fail, the relics in your backpack will have their quality halved. Not just the ones earned in the Colosseum, but also the ones you brought with you.

This is the kind of tension we’ve been aiming for, creating a more meaningful risk-reward dynamic. And to make things even more fun, a laurel crown will appear on Will’s head whenever he beats his previous record.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333092/edc217a9580a0a4c4982750620917780d96e7fee.gif"]
As mentioned previously, we’re introducing a new perk path: Hex.
This path allows you to curse enemies, deal damage over time, and transfer those effects to nearby targets, creating powerful chain reactions that work great with other combat perk paths.
It unlocks once you reach Endless Vault Challenge 2, with no additional requirements.
Another exciting addition to your armory is Blo-Blitz.

This weapon has its own rhythm, timing, and combat identity, built around constant pressure and rapid-fire attacks that keep enemies on edge. Add a perk that stacks power with every hit, and you’ve got yourself some serious mayhem.
To obtain it, you’ll need to complete a quest and acquire the crafting recipe. The quest becomes available once you visit Prison 2.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333092/161a4e83fcbc90277d7d5f4b7b46937d010bc320.gif"]
This shiny new armor set grants you one shield at the start of each dungeon, acting as an early safety net.

But here’s the twist. Once the shield breaks, your damage increases by 20% for 2 seconds. Suddenly, taking a hit can become part of the strategy. Time it well and turn broken defense into pure offense.
To obtain it, you’ll follow a similar process as with Blo-Blitz: complete a quest to unlock the crafting recipe. The quest appears once you reach Aeolia 2.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333092/8158b74295d38ce0e9720f2a7c62ed7a219f4ad9.jpg"]
We’ve also expanded and reworked several perk systems.
Event Room vendors such as Sliver, Nou, Anacard, and Andrei now offer many new perks, along with updates to existing ones.
Hazard perks like Spikes, Taser, and Genie have also been redesigned to better align with player control and synergy potential.
New gear isn’t the only place where you’ll be able to spend your hard-earned coins.
Eris is unlocking her fourth upgrade level, allowing you to invest in better potions and health improvements that make expeditions a bit safer.
Similarly, K33p3r is receiving a third upgrade level, expanding your possibilities inside the shop.
And speaking of expanding the shop...
We’re introducing two new customizable corners.
Upper Shelves
Whether you prefer tidy stacks or mysterious compartments, you can now turn practical storage into a way to show off your style.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333092/86126f7133b2f4aeeaf810e5d3fe3ec4052dc217.png"]
Storefront
This is the first thing customers see when entering your shop, and now you have full control over its look. Set the mood before anyone even reaches the counter.
Building visual identity and expression is one of our main goals during Early Access, especially when it comes to the shop. After all, it’s a space that should truly feel like your own.
So let us know in the comments how you’d like to customize the shop in future updates.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333092/a4f88e6442ccff705d3d5d667afbf42feaa3d394.jpg"]
Since this is Early Access, we also want to be transparent. There are a few known issues we’re currently working on to fix as soon as possible:
Clearing a room inside a colosseum may not properly complete the run and allow the player to continue.
Interacting with a chest exactly at the same moment as a new material notification appears may lead to a blocker.
Picking up relics in the backpack and changing menu tabs with a different input method may lead to a blocker.
Players starting new game may unlock two achievements simultaneously, one of which is supposed to unlock after entering Kalina through the Tresna portal later on.
Relic value and price fonts may appear a little out of scale especially in Asian languages.
Some of the new perks may not work fully as expected and may have misleading descriptions.
Game audio may sometimes stay muffled when skipping dialogues too fast. Restarting the game fixes the issue.

The Greed & Glory Update is only the first of several updates that will reflect your feedback as much as possible. You asked for higher stakes, deeper builds, and meaningful risk, and this is our first step in that direction.
But there’s more coming. Additional perks, weapons, armor, difficulty options, shop upgrades, and more are already planned for the next update.
This is just the beginning.
For now, let us know how far you’re willing to push your greed in the Colosseum, and keep stocking our shelves with feedback!
See you in Tresna!

items.text: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2350790/view/493841450487776474"]But today, we want to focus on a feature we haven’t shown you before - The Greed Colosseum, which will be part of the upcoming 1st Content Update!
One of the biggest pieces of feedback we’ve seen on Discord and Steam discussions is that you wanted higher risk-reward gameplay.
That’s why we built something to meet that need.
After defeating a boss, you’ll unlock an alternative path - The Greed Colosseum.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333092/edc217a9580a0a4c4982750620917780d96e7fee.gif"]
It’s a completely new challenge with exclusive rooms and escalating difficulty. Sliver discovered this dangerous realm, where only the bravest adventurers can test their skills.
The promise?
Legendary relics, more boss materials, and bigger rewards.
The cost?
If you fail… the relics in your backpack will see their quality halved. Not just the ones you earn in the Colosseum, but also the ones you brought with you.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333092/36b90cab664cba9a1a5a5ec9ff120f60cbcc19ff.gif"]
That’s why we named it that. Will you succumb to your inner greed and risk potential consequences?

That’s the kind of tension we’ve been aiming for, giving you a meaningful risk-reward dynamic. And to make it even more fun, a laurel crown will appear on Will’s head whenever he beats his previous record.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333092/161a4e83fcbc90277d7d5f4b7b46937d010bc320.gif"]

We definitely don’t want to reveal everything; some surprises will wait until March. But aside from all the new cosmetics, gear, and alternative paths, we’ve been working on additionalexciting things:
Perks Overhaul
Event Room vendors are getting a big injection of new perks, plus updates to existing ones.
New Upgrade Path
A new level of upgrades, which will let you invest in potions and health improvements to make expeditions safer.
We’ll share more details in our next news post on the release of Content Update 1 :)
We’re almost ready to release our first Content Update to Early Access - it’s just around the corner, and we cannot wait for you to try it!

Since this is Early Access, we want to be upfront. There are a few known issues we’re working on, like Endless Vault keys appearing too early on new saves or some missing sound triggers. We’re already tackling these and really appreciate that you’ve been reporting them on Discord and the Steam forums.
The Greed & Glory Update is just the beginning of the content planned before the game’s full release, so stay tuned as we continue fulfilling the milestones in our roadmap.🙂

Please keep sharing your thoughts wherever you’re most comfortable: Steam reviews, forums, Discord, or Reddit. We’re reading everything, and your feedback is actively guiding Will’s steps on his journey to release.
We’ll have more to share soon.
Until then, see you in Tresna!
~ Digital Sun and 11 bit studios Teams

releases.displayName: EA Progress #2 - First Look at What’s Coming In The First Content Update

items.text: Fellow merchants!

First of all, thank you for your every review, bug report, and thoughtful message you’ve shared since Early Access launched. We are thrilled that you want to take an active part in Moonlighter 2’s development. And we couldn’t be happier to welcome you behind the counter!

As outlined in our roadmap, this Early Access will focus on fewer but more substantial updates, rather than a constant stream of smaller patches. We’ll still be quick with hotfixes and bug fixes whenever needed, but for major updates, we want them to feel meaningful.

In the meantime, we want to be more transparent about what we’re building between those updates. That’s why these Early Access Updates exist: to show our current progress! And we are planning to consequently publish one update per month, until the full release of the game, to keep you posted!
So, let us show you what awaits you in the “Content Update 1” shall we? 👇
We’re expanding how you can personalize your shop with two brand-new customizable spots:
Drawers - whether you prefer tidy stacks or mysterious compartments, you can now turn practical storage into a way to show off your vibe!
Window displays - they’re the very first thing customers notice when they step inside, and now you get full control over what they see. Set the right mood before anyone even reaches the counter!
Alongside that, we’re adding 10+ new cosmetic items to help you shape the shop you want, whether you’re going for pure aesthetics, better vibes, or something that reflects your playstyle more.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333092/e38977f5eac053f2225f9b31592671679b919fb2.png"]
New Armor
A brand-new armor is forging its way into Tresna! This shiny new set grants you 1 Shield at the start of each dungeon run, giving you an early safety net.
But here’s the fun twist: when Shield breaks, your damage spikes by 20% for 2 seconds. Suddenly, getting hit is part of the plan! Time it right and turn a broken defense into a burst of pure offense.
Many of you were surprised when we added a gun to Moonlighter 2… and we love surprises!
That’s why we’re introducing the Blo-Blitz, Will’s very own dual-gun weapon.

Yes, dual. One in each hand. With two guns firing in tandem, cadence truly skyrockets. The Blo-Blitz has its own flow, its own timing, and a combat identity all about constant pressure and non-stop rapid-fire to keep enemies on their toes.
It might do less damage per shot, but some good synergies are about to be unlocked in the “Content Update 1”.
Introducing a new perk path: the Hex! At its core, Hex deals 20 damage and bounces to another active enemy. After 3 bounces, the Hex dissipates, so better build around it!

notes.title: Some Hex effects also behave a little differently

items.text: If Hex fails to bounce, its next hit becomes stronger
Certain effects cause Hex to detonate after 1.5 seconds, then jump into another enemy
Others let Hex stack, grow, or even explode multiple times
In short, Hex thrives in crowded fights and gets wild when enemies keep feeding it.
We know many of you are eager to return to Tresna, but for now, we unfortunately can’t share any specific dates for “Content Update 1” but it’s sooner than you think!
As we said at the beginning, we’ll make sure to keep you all posted every month as development moves forward.
We’d much rather ask you to wait a little longer than overpromise and fall short. After all, a merchant’s most valuable treasure isn’t gold. It’s your trust!

Right now, our main focus is polishing everything planned for “Content Update 1”. That includes even deeper shop customization, combat balance improvements, and a whole lot of refinement across the board.

On top of that, we’ll be sharing more sneak peeks of everything mentioned above on our Discord. Expect never-before-seen material, extra footage, and behind-the-scenes looks that won’t always make it into Steam updates.

Please keep sharing your thoughts wherever you’re most comfortable: Steam reviews, forums, Discord or Reddit. We’re reading everything, and your feedback is actively guiding Will’s steps on his journey to release.
We’ll have more to share soon.
Until then, see you in Tresna!
~ Digital Sun and 11 bit studios Teams
Fellow merchants!
First of all, we want to say a huge thank you for supporting Moonlighter 2 and its 1.0 release.

Since launch, we’ve been spending a lot of time with you: reading your reviews, going through your reports, and following your posts and conversations across Discord, Reddit, and the Steam Discussions. Your feedback has been incredibly valuable in helping us understand where the 1.0 experience needed some extra attention.

The result is this patch, which addresses most of the concerns raised by the community during the 1.0 release. We’ll keep reading, listening, and working on the game in the weeks and months to come, but we felt a hotfix was much needed so you can enjoy the 1.0 experience in a better, smoother way right now.

A big focus of this update is stability. While we’ve done our best to eliminate crashes and believe this version should be significantly more stable, if you still experience a crash, please fill out this form and let us know. Every report helps us track down the remaining issues.
• Added the option to select between DirectX 11 and DirectX 12. Many of the crashes and
performance issues some players have run into may be related to this — if you’re
experiencing instability or poor performance, try switching between the two to see
which runs best on your system.
Progression & Quests
• Fixed the quest marker for the Weapon Mastery quest pointing to the wrong location.
• Fixed a crash that could occur right after completing a certain main quest.
• Fixed a loss of player input when talking to Hazy Jane during later stages of the game.
• Fixed the game freezing on the loading screen when returning to Tresna during the
tutorial.
• Fixed Babyl sometimes becoming duplicated, which could make Spark almost
impossible to reach if Babyl hadn’t been unlocked yet.
• Fixed Senda not taking poison damage from gadget shots during his second phase.
• Fixed Sergeant Roberto not reacting when shot from a distance.
• Fixed the CH4 Turret getting stuck in its shooting animation after being tased.
• Fixed tased Electric Slimes still dealing electric field damage.
• Fixed a crash caused by a specific combination of Wound and Ignite perks.
• Fixed spearhead projectiles freezing in midair when reaching Will.
• Fixed the second greatsword’s sharpness drain not working as intended.
• Fixed The Vow weapon’s description not matching its actual behavior.
Armor
• Fixed players becoming invincible during boss fights after equipping the Scarabastion.
Dungeons
• Fixed a specific spot in Kalina where players could fall out of the map and get stuck with
no way to recover the run.
• Fixed Will being able to get stuck behind an obstacle in the Gallery area.
• Fixed Barrier Blessing shield charges not being restored when retrying a dungeon
• Fixed certain rewards not appearing in legendary chests dropped after defeating a
miniboss.
• Fixed the dungeon music not restarting after the Bloblet room if the player left before
its track ended.
• Fixed placeholder and debug text, along with a misspelling, in the Shared Secret relic’s
description (English and Portuguese).
First, we’ll work to bring these improvements to the console versions as soon as possible.

After that, we’ll assess what Moonlighter 2 still needs in terms of balancing, gameplay, and more. We’ll keep a close eye on our communities, your feedback, and the conversations happening around the game as we decide where our attention is needed next.
Please keep sharing your thoughts, reports, and experiences with us. We’re reading them, and they genuinely help us make Moonlighter 2 better.
See you in Tresna!
Take care,
~ Digital Sun and 11 bit studios Teams
Fellow merchants!

We’re back with yet another update to the Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault demo! This one brings some big improvements based directly on your reports and Steam reviews. We’re moving fast, and your feedback is proving to be ever so helpful. Keep it coming!
Let's see what's new in today's patch.
Resolved the black screen issue that was affecting many users with HDDs (especially during the intro sequence).
Major performance boost and smoother overall experience.
Demo size reduced from 27 GB to just 5 GB (yes, really!).
Enemy damage reduced by 20% across the board for better balance.
Improved stuttering issues.
Fixed a soft lock where Trained Taalik could get stuck on certain props.
Adjusted an enemy trigger that was activating as soon as you entered certain rooms.
Corrected the on-screen prompt in the shop showcase, which was displaying incorrect controls.
Fixed a typo in Sliver’s interaction prompt (it said “Hot touch” – not intentional 😅)
Added mouse-based combat aiming! It’s enabled by default, but you can toggle it in Settings if you prefer the classic feel.
Thank you again for your reports, your patience, and your incredible support. This is the second patch in two days, and we’re committed to making Moonlighter 2 the best it can be before release.

If you haven’t already, we’d love to hear your thoughts on the shop system, especially what you feel is missing or what made the original Moonlighter shop feel so special. Some of those changes may take time, as they involve deeper design decisions, but our goal remains the same: to deliver a shop system that’s engaging, strategic, and truly worthy of the series.

releases.displayName: Demo Update – Performance, UI, and Your Feedback

items.text: Fellow merchants!
We’re happy to announce that the update to the Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault demo is live!

It brings improved keyboard & mouse support - including smoother inventory management and better UI navigation. It’s not perfect yet, but it’s a step forward, and the whole team is already hard at work on more improvements across all control schemes.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333092/cabc6bd0e6691c3f4aa63af5dbd3e1b85ebcaa67.png"]

Thank you so much for playing the demo and sharing your thoughts. With Moonlighter 2 trending on Steam Next Fest, we’re thrilled to see so many of you stepping into the world of Tresna. But what’s truly overwhelming is the volume and care behind your feedback. From Discord to Steam to socials - now that we’re listening and are taking your comments seriously.

We know the demo isn’t flawless. You’ve flagged issues - from black screens to performance hiccups - and we want to assure you those are high on our list. Fixes are in progress. We won’t be able to address everything before the end of Next Fest, but this is just the beginning. This is the first demo of Moonlighter 2, and our journey together is far from over.
We’re building this game alongside you, and we’re committed to shaping it into something we can all be proud of.

Last update, we focused on the shop system - what’s new, what’s changed, and why. We’ve received a flood of insights from both returning Moonlighter 1 players and newcomers alike, and we’re so grateful for your honesty. If you haven’t shared your thoughts yet, please do! We’re especially keen to hear more about how the shop feels and what could make it more engaging, strategic, or satisfying.
🔗 Feedback Form
⚙️ Steam Discussion Thread
We’re learning. We’re trying. We’re improving - one update at a time.
Keep your feedback coming. Let’s make something truly special, together!
~ Digital Sun Team

issues.text: Our aim of releasing Moonlighter 2 in Early Access was to create the best experience possible, which brings you fun for a bunch of time, and we are taking our time and care to test each idea, or suggestion that comes from the community.
We definitely hear you loud and clear when it comes to the Colosseum, and we are aware of the issues you have addressed recently so far.

Right now, it’s not hitting the balance we want. Enemies can feel a bit too spongy, and the risk-reward ratio isn’t as satisfying as it should be. This is something we're already tackling. We just want to make sure we approach it carefully and implement changes properly.
That said, you can expect adjustments to this mode based directly on your feedback soon, as we constantly try to improve your experience.
We are also aware of some minor crashes and bugs, which we are constantly working on at the moment.
As always, keep the feedback coming. You’re helping us shape Moonlighter 2 every step of the way, and we couldn’t do this without you.
Stay tuned and see you next month!
~ Digital Sun and 11 bit studios Teams
